content:
Last weekend, Apple TV made multiple announcements at San Diego Comic-Con, including the premiere date for the fourth season of *Silo*, among other exciting news.

*Silo* season four will debut in the summer of 2027 and will serve as the show's final season.

*Silo* season three is currently airing (available to stream here), with new episodes releasing weekly through September 4.

However, at last weekend's San Diego Comic-Con, Apple not only provided updates on other sci-fi series but also delivered a major surprise for *Silo* fans.

*Silo* season four will premiere next summer, bringing the entire series to a close.

Below is the announcement post from Apple TV's X account:

In the streaming era, it has become commonplace for series to wait several years between new seasons, and this is especially true for high-budget sci-fi shows like *Silo*.

However, Apple has been proactive in accelerating the return of some series by greenlighting them ahead of time. In the case of *Silo*, seasons three and four were developed simultaneously and shot back-to-back.

*Silo* still has six weeks of new episodes left to air, but once this season concludes, viewers won't have to wait long for season four.

What are your thoughts on *Silo* season three so far? Feel free to share with us in the comments.

Apple TV's monthly subscription fee is US$12.99, and it is also available through the Apple One bundle.
